# Premier Warehouse & Logistics Management

> Woman-owned small business offering 3PL warehousing and logistics in Doral, Miami.
> 30,000 sq ft certified facility, 24/7 secured, over 25 years of combined experience.
> We speak Spanish.

## Key Facts

- Address: 3600 NW 114th Ave, Unit A, Doral, FL 33178
- Phone: +1 305 877 5964 and +1 305 429 5076
- Email: info@mypremierwarehouse.com
- Facility: 30,000 sq ft, 24/7 secure with onsite cameras, dock-height warehouse, ramps, free private parking, free Wi-Fi, meeting room, flex working space
- Certifications: MyFDA++, TSA, Doral Chamber of Commerce, FCBF, Woman Owned Small Business

## Services

- Storage: short & long term, dedicated space, secure cages or crates, temp control — standard rate $15.00/pallet/month
- Note: published rates are reference estimates and may vary; final quotes are confirmed by the logistics team.
- Cross Docking: 24-hour and weekend availability, Mon–Fri $250.00
- Transload: same day $9.00/pallet, next day pickup $10.50/pallet
- Pick & Pack: $10.00/pallet, shrink wrap, oversize handling
- E-Commerce Fulfillment, Inventory Management (WMS) with remote access, TIB services
- Trade Show Crate Storage, Specialized Handling, Last Mile & Drayage, Vehicle Loading
